This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]]. Multiple members,<ref name="TPoA" /> including [[Nadura]],<ref name="TPoH" /> could be found on the [[planet]] [[Corvus]].<ref name="TPoA" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their diverse skin colorations, which included various pale color palettes such as [[Color|pink]], green, or blue, though usually featured some gray around their faces. Additionally, this species had large [[Bone|craniums]], with exposed [[Nose|nostrils]], [[Eye|eyes]] with black sclera and either blue<ref name="TPoA" /> or yellow pupils,<ref name="TPoH" /> and small [[Ear|aural openings]] on the sides of their heads. This species was covered in spikes, including on their head, brow, and back, as well as the tops of their [[Limb|hands]], with a long, sharp spine also protruding from their inner wrist, forcing them to wear special sleeves with openings that allowed said spines to stick out.<ref name="TPoA" />

==Species in the galaxy==
A number of members of this species could be found living within the [[city]] of [[Calodan]] on the [[forest]] [[planet]] [[Corvus]] by sometime between<ref name="TPoA" /> [[9 BBY]] and [[2 BBY]].<ref name="Date2">{{TalesDate|E2}}</ref> One of these individuals, [[Nadura]], would eventually leave and become an [[ambassador]] for the [[New Republic]], returning to her home<ref name="TPoH" /> some years later<ref name="Date3">{{TalesDate|E3}}</ref> to offer [[Magistrate]] [[Morgan Elsbeth]] the opportunity for Corvus to be represented among the [[New Republic Senate]]. Instead, the Magistrate,<ref name="TPoH" /> and secret [[Nightsisters|Nightsister]]<ref name="TPoF">{{TOTE|The Path of Fear}}</ref> and [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] sympathizer,<ref name="TPoA" /> had [[Skirmish in Calodan|Nadura and her escort killed]],<ref name="TPoH" /> further oppressing her citizens until they were later liberated by [[Togruta]] [[Jedi]]-in-hiding [[Ahsoka Tano]] and the [[Mandalorian]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Din Djarin]].<ref name="The Jedi">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 13: The Jedi}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The species first appeared in "[[The Path of Anger]],"<ref name="TPoA" /> the second episode of ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Empire]]''. The episode aired [[May 4]], [[2024]]<ref name="Trailer Revealed">{{SW|url=news/tales-of-the-empire-trailer|text=''Star Wars: Tales of the Empire'' Trailer Revealed}}</ref>
